one_line: The paper develops and validates an automated method (via an ISO 50001 EnMS reading SCADA data) to identify electricity-saving projects for pumping, refrigeration, compressed-air and water-supply systems on a South African deep gold mine — a mining/utility context, not continuous-flow industrial production.
